actions-list.actionItem: The Speaker announced that the House do now adjourn pursuant to clause 13 of Rule I. The next meeting is scheduled for 12:00 p.m. on November 30, 2026.

actions-list.header: National Advisory Committee on Institutional Quality and Integrity
actions-list.actionItem: Pursuant to 20 U.S.C 1011c, and the order of the House of January 3, 2025, the Speaker appointed, for a term of six years, upon the recommendation of the Majority Leader: Ms. Jennifer Blum, Arlington, Virginia, Mr. Mark Brenner, Phoenix, Arizona, and Ms. Erin Valdez, Cedar Park, Texas, and upon the recommendation of the Minority Leader: Mr. Benjamin Cannon, Portland, Oregon.
The House received a communication from Representative Hern (OK) wherein he resigns as a member of the House of Representatives effective on November 27, 2026.

The House received a message from the Clerk. Pursuant to the permission granted in Clause 2(h) of Rule II of the Rules of the U.S. House of Representatives, the Clerk notified the House that he had received the following message from the Secretary of the Senate on November 24, 2026, at 3:24 p.m.: That the Senate passed H.R. 2347 with an amendment.
The Chair led the House in reciting the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.
Pursuant to clause 13 of Rule I, the Journal of the last day's proceedings was approved.
Today's prayer was offered by the House Chaplain, Chaplain Margaret Grun Kibben.
The Speaker designated the Honorable Adrian Smith to act as Speaker pro tempore for today.
The House convened, starting a new legislative day.
